item.tib: snyan rgyud rig pa gcer mthong ngag don gsal byed
item.coloph: de ltar snyan rgyud rig pa gcer mthong gi ngag don gsal byed 'di ni/ 'gro mgon lhun grub 'od zer dang / rtogs ldan khra thul ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi phyag len ltar/ bla ma rin po che spyang tshe shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi gsang rgyun bzhin du/ bshes gnyen dam pa drang srong g.yung drung shes rab kyi thugs bzhed du/ rje btsun rin po che 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/ khyung po'i sgom can dpal 'byor lhun grub zhes bya bas/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su sbyar ba dge'o//
